anova.removedBank:
\(m\): number of groups; \(n\): subjects per group; \(\bar{\bar x}\): grand mean.

\[H_0:\mu_1=\cdots=\mu_m;\quad H_1:\text{not all means equal}\]\[s_{\mathrm{wit}}^2=\frac{\sum s_i^2}{m},\quad\bar{\bar x}=\frac{\sum\bar x_i}{m}\]\[s_{\bar x}^2=\frac{\sum(\bar x_i-\bar{\bar x})^2}{m-1},\quad s_{\mathrm{bet}}^2=ns_{\bar x}^2\]\[F=\frac{s_{\mathrm{bet}}^2}{s_{\mathrm{wit}}^2},\quad\nu_n=m-1,\quad\nu_d=m(n-1)\]

bonferroni.removedBank:
\(k\): requested comparisons; \(\alpha_T\): family significance; \(\nu\): ANOVA residual df.

\[k=\begin{cases}m(m-1)/2&\text{all pairs}\\m-1&\text{each vs control}\end{cases}\]\[\mathrm{SE}_{ij}=\sqrt{s_{\mathrm{wit}}^2(1/n_i+1/n_j)}\]\[|t_{ij}|=\frac{|\bar x_i-\bar x_j|}{\mathrm{SE}_{ij}},\quad\alpha_{\mathrm{pair}}=\alpha_T/k\]

binary.removedBank:
\(m\): number of events; \(n\): total subjects; code event 1, other 0.

\[\hat p=m/n,\quad\widehat{\operatorname{Var}}(X)=\hat p(1-\hat p)\]\[\widehat{\operatorname{SD}}(X)=\sqrt{\hat p(1-\hat p)},\quad\operatorname{SE}(\hat p)=\sqrt{\frac{\hat p(1-\hat p)}n}\]

z-yates.removedBank: \[H_0:p_1=p_2,\quad H_1:p_1\ne p_2\]\[\hat p_i=m_i/n_i,\quad\hat p=\frac{m_1+m_2}{n_1+n_2}\]\[\mathrm{SE}_0=\sqrt{\hat p(1-\hat p)(1/n_1+1/n_2)}\]\[c_Y=\tfrac12(1/n_1+1/n_2),\quad D_Y=\max(0,|\hat p_1-\hat p_2|-c_Y)\]\[|z_Y|=D_Y/\mathrm{SE}_0\]
